patches.notes:
**Gensou Maden Saiyuuki Retribution - Hi no Ataru Basho de** is a 2000 board and management game for the WonderSwan Color, based on Kazuya Minekura's *Saiyuki*. It was released only in Japan.

Sanzo's party has lost the Three Aspects' credit card and ran up a bill eating and fighting at an inn. To pay it off, they run festival food stalls for the four sisters who own the inn: Meifan, Loran, Liyi and Xiao. You pick a sister, roll dice on a town board, place signs that bring customers to the stalls, meet lucky and unlucky events and play Blackjack, until the debt is paid.

> **Please read:** this translation was made **entirely with AI**, as a personal project. It is shared as it is for anyone who wants to play, but it must **never be uploaded to romhacking sites** (romhacking.net and the like). It isn't up to the standard of a real fan translation and doesn't belong there.

**How to patch**

Apply the .bps to *Gensou Maden Saiyuuki Retribution - Hi no Ataru Basho de (Japan) (Rev 2).wsc* (2 MB, CRC32 446E2581) with Floating IPS, beat or ROM Patcher JS. The result is CRC32 009E038F; keep the .wsc extension.

With Floating IPS on the command line:

    flips --apply "Gensou Maden Saiyuuki Retribution - Hi no Ataru Basho de (EN v0.9).bps" "Gensou Maden Saiyuuki Retribution - Hi no Ataru Basho de (Japan) (Rev 2).wsc" "Gensou Maden Saiyuuki Retribution - Hi no Ataru Basho de (EN v0.9).wsc"

You must provide your own copy of the original Japanese game to apply …
